description.narrative:
General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2015Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: The strategic plan for 2014 called for structural changes and a reorganisation was implemented during the year. Namely ´role of HR unit was increased, it was renamed HR Development and Management Office and was charged to address issues of improving working environment, raise awareness of the staff, especially newly recruited offering them introduction training courses. Regional offices of Kakheti and Kartli were given more power in monitoring of processes. In the end all these have had a positive effect for employees as well as both debtors and creditors, since NBE has become more oriented towards its customers with new functions like Parties´ Interests Protection Office” among others.
The ratio of enforced cases to unresolved cases has shown a very positive trend. The bailiffs are now working in small teams and discriminating between ordinary and complicated cases allows for a smother flow in the business process, eliminating unnecessary bottlenecks.
